name: Mumbai
operatingHours: Metro Line 3 (Aqua, Cuffe Parade–Aarey JVLR, underground via CSMT and both airport terminals) runs ~5:55 AM–~11:25 PM; the other metro lines (1, 2A, 7 and newer sections) run ~5:30 AM–~11:30 PM, every ~4–10 min. Suburban 'local' trains (Western, Central and Harbour lines, the city's real backbone) run ~4:00 AM–~1:00 AM and are extremely crowded at peaks. The Monorail (Chembur–Jacob Circle) has been suspended for a signalling upgrade since 2025 and had no restart date as of Aug 2026.
fareInfo: Metro fares are distance-based: Line 1 ₹10–40, Line 3 ₹10–70, Lines 2A/7 ₹10–80, as QR tickets via apps or station counters; the Mumbai One app/NCMC card covers several lines. Local trains: second class from ₹5, first class from ~₹50, AC locals from ~₹30; buy on the UTS app or at counters (no on-board sales). Buses (BEST) from ~₹10.

hotels.name: ITC Maratha, a Luxury Collection Hotel
Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Palm Grove

sights.name: Gateway of India
sights.note: A basalt triumphal arch on the Apollo Bunder waterfront, built for the 1911 royal visit and now the departure point for Elephanta ferries.
sights.hours: Open 24 hours (grounds may close during events)

sights.name: Shree Siddhivinayak Temple
sights.note: Mumbai's most visited Ganesh temple in Prabhadevi, with a gold-plated dome and long, fast-moving darshan queues, longest on Tuesdays.
sights.hours: ~5:30 AM–~10:00 PM daily (earlier opening on Tuesdays)

sights.name: Marine Drive
sights.note: A 3.6 km seafront promenade curving from Nariman Point to Chowpatty, lined with Art Deco buildings and nicknamed the Queen's Necklace for its lights after dark.

sights.name: Bandra-Worli Sea Link
sights.note: A cable-stayed toll bridge arching across Mahim Bay; it carries cars only, so watch it from the Bandra Fort ramparts and Bandstand promenade.
sights.hours: Viewpoint open ~6:00 AM–~9:00 PM; bridge open 24 hours to vehicles

sights.name: Elephanta Caves
sights.note: Rock-cut Shiva cave temples from the 5th–7th centuries on an island in the harbour, famous for the three-headed Trimurti sculpture; a ~1 hour ferry from the Gateway of India.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–5:30 PM, closed Mon; ferries from the Gateway ~9:00 AM–~2:00 PM, last return ~5:30 PM

sights.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
sights.note: A working railway station that doubles as a UNESCO-listed Victorian Gothic masterpiece of domes, turrets and carved stone, busiest at rush hour.
sights.hours: Station open 24 hours; heritage gallery walks on weekdays

sights.name: Global Vipassana Pagoda
sights.note: A huge gilded meditation dome at Gorai on the city's northern edge, modelled on Yangon's Shwedagon, with a free exhibition on the Buddha's life.

sights.name: Juhu Beach
sights.note: A long, busy suburban beach where families stroll at sunset and stalls sell pav bhaji and kulfi; not for swimming.
sights.hours: Open 24 hours; busiest in the evening

sights.name: Mahalaxmi Dhobi Ghat
sights.note: A vast open-air laundry of concrete wash pens where hundreds of washermen scrub the city's clothes, best seen from the bridge by Mahalaxmi station.
sights.hours: Viewable ~6:00 AM–~6:00 PM; busiest in the morning

sights.name: Mani Bhavan Gandhi Museum
sights.note: The modest house where Gandhi stayed on his Mumbai visits, with his room, letters, books and a series of dioramas of his life.

sights.name: Kanheri Caves
sights.note: More than 100 Buddhist caves carved into a forested hillside inside Sanjay Gandhi National Park, with a giant chaitya hall and standing Buddhas.
sights.hours: ~7:30 AM–5:00 PM, closed Mon (park entry fee plus cave ticket)

sights.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya
sights.note: The former Prince of Wales Museum, an Indo-Saracenic building with strong galleries of Indian sculpture, miniature paintings and decorative arts.

sights.name: Mahalakshmi Temple
sights.note: A seaside temple to the goddess of wealth on Bhulabhai Desai Road, its lanes packed with flower and sweet stalls.

sights.name: Haji Ali Dargah
sights.note: A white 15th-century mosque and Sufi shrine on an islet, reached by a causeway that floods at high tide.
sights.hours: ~5:30 AM–~10:00 PM daily; causeway walkable at low tide

sights.name: Mount Mary Basilica
sights.note: A hilltop neo-Gothic church in Bandra revered by people of all faiths, focus of a week-long fair each September.

sights.name: Colaba Causeway
sights.note: Colaba's main street of colonial arcades, street stalls, cafés and old bars such as Leopold Café, good for an evening wander.

sights.name: Girgaum Chowpatty
sights.note: The beach at the north end of Marine Drive, where evening crowds snack on bhel puri and the city's biggest Ganesh immersions take place.

sights.name: Crawford Market
sights.note: Mahatma Phule Market, a Victorian market hall with Lockwood Kipling friezes, selling fruit, spices and dry goods amid noisy lanes.

railStations.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
railStations.note: Mumbai's Gothic-revival UNESCO-listed terminus for Central Railway long-distance trains (Pune, Goa via the Konkan line, Delhi, Kolkata) and the Central and Harbour suburban lines; CSMT Metro (Line 3) is next door.
railStations.hours: Long-distance trains by timetable; suburban ~4:00 AM–~1:00 AM; Metro ~5:55 AM–~10:30 PM departures.

railStations.name: Mumbai Central
railStations.note: Western Railway terminus for Rajdhani, Vande Bharat and other trains to Delhi, Gujarat and Rajasthan, with Western-line suburban platforms alongside; Jagannath Shankar Sheth Metro station (Line 3) is a short walk away on the subway map.
railStations.hours: Long-distance trains by timetable; suburban ~4:00 AM–~1:00 AM.

airports.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport
airports.transitNote: Metro Line 3 (Aqua, on the subway map) has stations at both terminals (CSMIA International T2 and CSMIA Domestic) and runs south via BKC, Dadar and Worli to CSMT and Cuffe Parade in ~50–60 min for ~₹60–70. Taxis and app cabs take 45–90 min to South Mumbai depending on traffic. The new Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMI) is ~35 km east and not on the metro yet.
airports.hours: Line 3 first train ~5:55 AM, last departures ~10:30 PM. Late arrivals: prepaid taxi or app cab.
